value.body:
I just created my account and created a repo. However, I found that my profile page 404, although it's accessible via did:

- [Profile page (404)](https://tangled.org/superkenvery.tngl.sh)
- [Profile via did (normal)](https://tangled.org/did:plc:cnx5rmsyvousaqjfbbzzllbi?tab=overview)

What's more, I can't push to the repo, even though I (think I) correctly configured the ssh keys:

```
git push -u tangle HEAD
Enumerating objects: 170, done.
knot: couldn't read the account records needed to check your ssh key, retry shortly
send-pack: unexpected disconnect while reading sideband packet
Counting objects: 100% (170/170), done.
Delta compression using up to 8 threads
Compressing objects: 100% (154/154), done.
fatal: the remote end hung up unexpectedly
```

(But I successfully pushed as of writing this. Profile page is still 404 though)
value.title: New user: Profile page 404, git push fails
